title: Profile
description: A viewer's personalization profile, set in the onboarding sheet, kept in the browser and sent with the WebSocket subscription. Cards are written per profile hash.

mode.description: analyst: dense, tactical. casual: short, emotional, no jargon. player_cam: everything about one player. kids: simple and upbeat.

language.description: en = English, pcm = Nigerian Pidgin, yo = Yoruba, fr = French, es = Spanish.

focus_metric.description: The one stat shown in a persistent bug.
